source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.6.0, data build 946, released 2026-09-02

data.summary: Ranged weapons your **ADEPTUS ASTARTES** models carry gain **[[HEAVY]](vsdata:weapon-ability/heavy)**. For a weapon that already had **[[HEAVY]](vsdata:weapon-ability/heavy)**, each of its attacks gets +1 to its **Wound roll** when the attacker's unit has **[Remained Stationary](vsdata:core-rule/remain-stationary)** in that turn.

lastPrinted.note: Build 963, in force at this version's cutoff, no longer prints the Anvil Siege Force Detachment; this rule is as build 946, the last to print it, gives it.
